items.statement: The computed excited-state pattern should be interpreted as evidence for or against the proposed electronic rationale for rapid visible-light photocyclization.
items.expected: The conclusion correctly synthesizes the two intense states and their orbital character, and states that this supports (or fails to support) a photocyclization rationale only within the model and validation scope.

items.statement: Vertical TD-DFT and orbital inspection have bounded interpretive scope.
items.expected: The report distinguishes vertical absorption/orbital evidence from a complete photochemical mechanism, rate or quantum-yield determination and records model sensitivity or unspecified settings.
